summary: Short Clarence Road kerb with houses 8-13 m away and a No Parking sign.
reasons: No Parking Any Time sign on kerb

best_section.where: Clarence Road west kerb at the bend, just south of the junction

drivers.seclusion: House 13 m away at the start, with two more houses 8-9 m away by 11-15 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb lane with a couple of cars stopped; narrow verge, tree-lined.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road with a junction at the north end.
drivers.convention: No Parking Any Time sign 2.4 m from the kerb line; cars still stop there.

flags: No Parking Any Time sign at the kerb
sun_shade: Tree canopy over the kerb; shade from the east side in the morning.
